Parse quoted Jinja variables in SQL text without recovery

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using TreeSitterLanguagePack;

var result = TreeSitterLanguagePackConverter.Process("CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE t(`a` string, `b` array<string>)\nPARTITIONED BY (`p` string)\nROW FORMAT SERDE 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe'\nSTORED AS INPUTFORMAT 'x' OUTPUTFORMAT 'y'\nLOCATION 's3://{{bucket}}/t/'\nTBLPROPERTIES ('k'='v');", new ProcessConfig { Language = "jinja2" });
Console.WriteLine(result.Language);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metrics.ErrorCount);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metrics.TotalBytes);
```
